verdict.rationale: A hands-on user report says RustDesk detected two host screens and let them click 1 or 2 to choose which to show, which covers monitor selection and switching during a session. Nothing in the pack shows streaming a single window or app, and no first-party documentation describes multi-monitor handling. missing for 10: per-window/app streaming, first-party documentation of monitor selection and mid-session switching, more than one independent corroboration.
